datasheet_identity.title: DSS12 THRU DSS210 Schottky Rectifier Diodes

extraction_notes: The datasheet publishes grouped DSS12-DSS14 typical curves; DSS14 uses the grouped DSS12-DSS14 trace.
The reverse-current table also publishes a Ta = 100 degC maximum of 10 mA at VRM = VRRM; the schema has one reverse-current slot and records the 25 degC row.
No junction-capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published.
manufacturer: Jiangsu Changjing Electronics Technology Co Ltd
omission_reason: No capacitance, reverse-recovery, or breakdown data are published; the forward voltage table contains one point and the characteristic plots are grouped by device range.
